name: retronvim
description: minimal whichkey, lazyvim, warp, yazi, zsh and kanata setup

configurationDefaults.editor.fontFamily: 'FiraCode Nerd Font', Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace

args.text: zb install karabiner-elements ffmpeg poppler vlc

bindings.name: install nix-env ffmpeg poppler vlc zathura (linux)

args.text: Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope CurrentUser; iwr get.scoop.sh | iex
scoop bucket add extras; scoop install vlc ffmpeg popper

bindings.name: restart retronvim (required after installing brew nix-env scoop) (windows needs to relaunch vscode)

args.text: defaults write -g InitialKeyRepeat -int 10 && defaults write -g KeyRepeat -int 1

bindings.name: start touchcursor keyboard layout on Windows 10/11 (LeftCtrl + Space + Escape to stop)
start touchcursor keyboard layout on Linux/Macos (LeftCtrl + Space + Escape to stop)
install retronvim/nvim + retronvim/yazi + retronvim/zsh on windows terminal
